labels.rationale: Usage question: strip markup with Text.from_markup(...).plain, documented in docs/source/markup.rst.

items.body:
To get the plain text without the style tags, convert the string with `Text.from_markup(...)` and read its `.plain` attribute. This works for the `[red]`-style markup and the color names in your text. See [Console markup](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst) for the markup syntax.

For a related case with `RichHandler`, see #2016.

This is a usage question, so please ask it in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), where the maintainer can convert or close it.
